name: Matheme — The Four Files
description: Definition, process, quilt and music: the Binary Explication four-file circuit as 28 addressable matheme scenes, from "I see x" to the musical-epistemic return. Source revision dbf3b17; census T25.

text.title: §0/1 — The Matheme
text.italic: The sentence exposes its mediation; the signs are earned after, not before.
text.body: "I see x" rewritten as "I am aware of the seeing of x" separates the act from the fact in which it appears. Only then are the signs assigned: 0 unobjectifiable awareness, 1 determinate content, / the mediation — giving 0/1. File 1 earns the short chain 0/1 = 4+2 = 5→0 = 0/1, each compression owing an operation. Ordinary arithmetic still evaluates 0/1 as zero; the chain relates structural readings, not scalar values.

text.title: §0 — −/− = AND/OR / X/x
text.italic: Two marks before their names; placement differentiates.
text.body: Stripped of assigned names, 0/1 leaves −/−: two marks of one kind, placement, and the stroke. OR selects either position; AND holds their co-presence in one relation — AND/OR names a paired relational demand, not a Boolean table. As X/x, capital capacity and lower-case instance keep identity legible through difference; parallel strokes form =, and / through it gives ≠ — identity under cut.

text.italic: Difference is identity under cut; the count is four appearances plus two operative marks.
text.body: Parallel strokes form =; the slash through them forms ≠ — difference as identity under cut. The expansion / = ( = =/≠ ≠ ) holds identity-pole, difference-pole and their exposed middle as one field. Opened analytically it counts four appearances plus the two operative marks / and =: 4+2=6 — a declared operation, not a contradiction. File 1 applies the relation to knowing as Ø/X and (0/Ø)/(1/X).

text.italic: A counted relation remains a relation; the recount pairs terms with what holds them.
text.body: The copula counts four appearances plus two operative marks: 4+2. Held as one hinge, the middle =/≠ gives three read terms with the fourth as contextual holding: 4+2 → (3+1)+2 — a change of accounting level, not of criterion. Pairing the three terms with /, () and = gives Being, Becoming, Knowing/unKnowing — a local 3:3 whose complete articulation returns the count to the slash: the local 5→0.

text.title: §5 — The Six Determinations
text.italic: Ground becomes answerable through six determinations, bracketed by parent and return.
text.body: The qualitative body: 0/1 Ground, ?/! Definition, −/+ Dynamis, X/x Pattern, AM/IS Context, ∞/dx Realisation — each transition derived, not assigned from the count. The parent −/− precedes and 1/0 returns: eight turns, (4+2)+2, the interior body six. Harmonics pair Being, Becoming, Knowing/unKnowing; folds pair Essence 0+5, Constitution 1+4, Text–Texture 2+3. The foundation of mind remains unfound by the mental.

entities.name: SILENCE at #5 — not a fifth value

text.title: §5→0 — The Catuṣkoṭi Crossing
text.italic: 0 IS AND/OR IS-NOT 1 — four corners, one lived movement.
text.body: File 1 crosses 0 IS AND/OR IS-NOT EQUAL TO 1. IS: the phenomenon belongs to awareness in its act. IS-NOT: awareness is not consumed by what appears. BOTH holds the two without fusing their offices. NEITHER turns the apparatus on its own condition — no member of the predicative set can assume the office of the whole condition; 1/0 marks that limit. SILENCE at #5 is not a fifth value but the recognition in which the four become one movement.

text.title: §0/1–§5→0 — The Immutable Subject
text.italic: What can be noticed as an operation belongs to the field being known.
text.body: If a claimed cessation of the subject is known, the knowing presupposes a witness-position. Native assignments: 0 subject-position, Ø apparent subject, X object-field, 1 integrated unity, Ø/X the instrument as medium, (0/Ø)/(1/X) both recognitions in one field. What can be noticed as an operation — buddhi determines, ahaṃkāra appropriates, manas coordinates — belongs to the field being known, never to the subject-office.

scenes.name: AND + OR — the geometry of space-time
scenes.character: AND + OR — the geometry of space-time

text.title: AND + OR — The Geometry of Space-Time
text.italic: Two qualities make four composites; the count crosses the diameter.
text.body: Concatenation gives 00, 01, 10, 11; with the retained singles: 2+2² = 6. Placed N 00 · E 01 · W 10 · S 11, with 0 centre and 1 circumference, the traversal crosses the diameter — 01 → 10 turns 180°, the phase-flip inside the first pass. Endpoint identification [0,1]/(0∼1) ≅ S¹ makes return constructive; three counted advances give 3/4; three complementary pairs recover from the figure.

text.italic: The completed figure faces its condition; reversal carries phase, and a second application restores it.
text.body: The hinge 0/1 = / ≠ 1/0 holds the two orientations as one structure in different phases. The inverse tuple carries F(5−j) at slot j′: one reversal changes order, a second restores it — F → R(F) → F. Re-entry carries phase; accumulated history needs the passage sequence. As arithmetic 0/1=0 and 1/0 is undefined; the operation uses the ordered orientation, not the evaluated fractions.

text.title: AND/OR — The Onto-Logic
text.italic: Four slash-forms have different mathematical conditions; neither zero-denominator form defines a quotient.
text.body: Four slash-forms, four conditions: 0/0 = % — every q solves 0q=0, indeterminate capacity; 0/1 = 0 = 0% — expression; 1/0 = ?/! — no q solves 0q=1, question held in assertion; 1/1 = 1 = 100% — achieved wholeness. Lack of solution and lack of uniqueness are distinct obstructions. Each parent (0/1)/(1/0), (1/0)/(0/1) bears the complete 4+2, the final one as 4′+2′.

text.italic: The inverse field accounts for its passage; two equations meet in standing unity.
text.body: First equation: 0=(0/0) → (0/1)/(1/0) → [T₀] → [T₁] → (1/0+0/1) → 1/1 = 1 = 100% — the bridge gathers the directed arcs; it is not a sum of real fractions. Six stages partition 3:3; following the second three gives one recognition: 3:3 is also 3:1. Second equation: 2⁶+6² = 64+36 → 64/36 → ÷4 → 16/9 = 2⁴/3² → 4+2; and (16/9)(9/8) = 2 — return through the retained difference.

text.title: Ratio Threshold — 16/9 = (4/3)²
text.italic: A completed account yields a proportion; the doubled fourth retains a remainder.
text.body: 16/9 = 2⁴/3² = (4/3)² — the fourth taken twice; the denominator keeps 3²=9 where 2³=8, the asymmetric flip load-bearing. Cross-comparison (4:2) with (3:3) gives (4/3, 2/3); reciprocals give the four directions. The octave stands to the doubled fourth as the fifth to the fourth: 2/(16/9) = (3/2)/(4/3) = 9/8 — and (4/3)(9/8)(4/3) = 2.

text.italic: Adjacent harmonics, complementary folds; two maps of one sixfold, meeting without merging.
text.body: Adjacent pairs: Being {0,1} sum 1, Becoming {2,3} sum 5, Knowing {4,5} sum 9 — successive differences four. Folds: Essence {0,5}, Constitution {1,4}, Text-Texture {2,3}, each sum 5. The partitions share exactly {2,3}: two maps of one sixfold, meeting without merging. The harmonics' mutual dependence is named Borromean — a field, a passage and a recognition each require the other two.

text.italic: One address holds distinct exact readings; a crosswalk has to preserve every operation it connects.
text.body: One address, many exact readings: #4 carries binary 11 (value three), slash-form 1/1 (value one), formal-count 0, determination AM/IS, and a nested person field (3+1)+2. ?/! sits at #1 qualitatively and at #3 processually — different offices of one sign. The traversal 1,2,3,4,5,0 carries count 1,2,3,0,4,5; the offset is exact, the count read by function.

text.title: §0 — The Etymological Ground
text.italic: VALUE→MEASURE→RATIO→EQUATION→PRODUCT→SOLVE — an operational circuit, not a genealogy.
text.body: The circuit VALUE → MEASURE → RATIO → EQUATION → PRODUCT → SOLVE: mattering, mark, proportion, stated equality, consequence, release. An exact allocation treated as permanently self-grounding arrests the operation at its product; SOLVE returns it so the altered situation can be measured again. Harmonics: VALUE/MEASURE Being, RATIO/EQUATION Becoming, PRODUCT/SOLVE Knowing/unKnowing. The root labels are proposals, not verified passages.

text.title: §1 — The Jungian Architecture
text.italic: Six views upon X=x — identity-through-difference as an operation, not two independent things.
text.body: Native X=x: X unexhausted reserve, x the capacity for specification, = the equating power. Six views of one equation: X, x, X/x, X=x, X=(x), (X=x)=X/x — not six subjects. The context move asks how a settled self-description is sustained; the parentheses of X=(x) bound the determination as permeable conditions or defended walls. Maria's axiom carries the sesquitertian 4/3 as its exact proportional carrier.

text.title: §2 — The Pythagorean Number
text.italic: The evolution of the equation: six exact operations, one bifurcation, one modular return.
text.body: The equation evolves: 1+1=2, 1+2=3, 1+2+3=6 (the proper divisors), 1+2+3=1×2×3=6, then 0+1+2+3=6 beside 0×1×2×3=0 — the operators carry the distinction — and 6≡0 (mod 6), a quotient operation that does not turn integer 6 into 0. The trig family gives a concrete 2+4: two initial functions, four derived. Seven convergences are an inventory of witnesses, not seven independent proofs.

text.title: §3 — The Topological Form
text.italic: A loop returns to its surface address while its lift retains the displacement.
text.body: (x,y) ∼ (x+m,y+n) gives T² = ℝ²/ℤ²; the glued square has V=1, E=2, F=1, χ=0. A loop t↦(2t,t) closes on the surface while its lift ends at (2,1): π₁(T²) ≅ ℤ×ℤ, the cover infinite-sheeted. Pitch gets a quotient too: u = log₂(f/f₀) under u ∼ u+n gives ℝ/ℤ ≅ S¹. Two six-orbits of step 2 are not automatically two generators of a product torus.

entities.name: the three upāyas through the harmonics

text.title: §4 — Kashmir Shaivism: The Metaphysical Architecture
text.italic: Prakāśa-Vimarśa: six major turns, recognition retaining the differentiation.
text.body: Prakāśa-Vimarśa: awareness and its self-apprehending power, related without either becoming substance — 0/1 and 1/0, a relational identity that is not scalar equality. Six turns: Anuttara, Śiva–Śakti, Sadāśiva/Īśvara, Sadvidyā/Māyā, kañcukas+Puruṣa, Pratyabhijñā. 36=6² is exact arithmetic; the six-by-six identification of the tattvas remains Offered. An asserted cessation cannot remove the presupposed position of appearing.

text.title: §5 — Epi-Logos: The Proof Gathered
text.italic: Five registers, six positions — read between without flattening.
text.body: Five registers, six positions: Value/X/1+1=2 · Measure/x/1+2=3 · Ratio/X/x/1+2+3=6 · Equation/X=x/hinge · Product/X=(x)/zero-gate · Solve/(X=x)=X/x/modular return. At return: modulo 6 the count reaches residue 0; the torus loop keeps its lift displacement — both specified returns retaining different information. The quilt returns by 0/1=4+2=5→0=0/1; the Night pass is a separate sequence.

text.title: §5→0 — The Enantiodromic Return
text.italic: The Night pass turns the seen structure into the question of inhabiting it.
text.body: The Night pass turns IS toward AM; its #0′–#5′ are Night-pass addresses, distinct from File 2's inverse-phase primes. Name descends Truth→Mind→Word→Logos→Son→Image; Power crystallises Play→Need→Sacrifice→Decision→Love→Work. The diagnostic: absolutise Ø, X, Ø/X or 0 and a real operation suppresses its relation. The Möbius Stitch: AM carries the first-person enactment of the relation displayed as IS.

text.title: The Foundational Ratios
text.italic: 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 ≡ 100% — the standing identity from which the ratio body is earned.
text.body: The standing identity 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 ≡ 100% opens the ratio body: 100 = 64+36, so 64/36 = 16/9 = (4/3)². Cross-comparison gives (4/3, 2/3); reciprocation the four directions. Three routes converge on the epogdoon — (2/1)/(16/9), (3/2)/(4/3), (2·6²)/2⁶ = 9/8 — and (16/9)(9/8) = 2. The canonical set: 1/1, 4/3, 3/4, 3/2, 2/3, 16/9, 9/8, 2/1.

text.title: The Two Chromatic Substrates
text.italic: One palette, two traversals; the slash-flip is one operation whose interval-character is contextual.
text.body: Two orders of the twelve classes: chromatic p_c = 2k+ε, whole-tone orbits WT₀ and WT₁; fifths p_f = 7k+6ε, one twelve-orbit. The same-position flip σ(k,ε)=(k,1−ε), σ²=id, is a semitone in the chromatic basis and the tritone in the fifths: E↔F against D↔G♯. One operation, contextual interval-character. Pure closure keeps its remainder: (9/8)⁶/2 = (3/2)¹²/2⁷ = 531441/524288.

entities.name: nine entries · eight pairs · seven tetrads

text.title: The Universal Pairing Grammar
text.italic: Three families and one conjugating operator; nine entries, eight pairs, seven unique tetrads.
text.body: A — adjoins {(0,1),(2,3),(4,5)}; B — mirrors {(0,5),(1,4),(2,3)}, each pair summing to five; C — crosses {(1,2),(3,4),(5,0)}. The shared (2,3) is where adjacency and mirror meet: nine entries, eight distinct pairs. D admits conjugacy — (n,n′) is the Spanda pulse, semitone or tritone by basis. Pair with D-both image: seven unique tetrads from nine uses; pairing is invariant under common shift.

text.title: The Lens as Epistemic Anchor
text.italic: Lens-modulation is epistemic-mode-modulation; transposing a phrase alone does not specify the mode.
text.body: Twelve lens IDs at the twelve addresses; chromatic anchors C D E F♯ G♯ A♯ / C♯ D♯ F G A B. Re-anchoring r_a(p) = p−a (mod 12) keeps the sounds fixed and changes their reference; transposition moves the sounds — if both move, relative addresses are preserved. Lens-modulation is epistemic-mode-modulation. Partition: 8 inner + 4 framing = 12; complementary return R(k,ε)=(5−k,1−ε), R²=id.

text.title: The Diatonic CF Grammar
text.italic: Seven frames select the diatonic body; the tetrachords carry exact return.
text.body: CF1–CF4 articulate 0/1; CF5 is recursive — the sixfold active within position 4; CF6 bridges; CF7 returns (5/0). At Lens 0 the selections give C major: S = {0,2,4,5,7,9,11}, steps 2,2,1,2,2,2,1 — five inner, two framing, the full palette used. Pure ratios: tetrachord 4/3, bridge 9/8, leimma (4/3)/(9/8)² = 256/243. E→F flips face in place; B→C changes 5′→0. Twelve scales × seven grounds = 84 configurations.

text.title: The Mode–Tonic Field and Voicing Landscape
text.italic: Two choices give a field; the count is exact when the objects counted remain explicit.
text.body: Two products: the modal field |M| = 12×7 = 84, and the cluster/bass landscape |V| = 12×12 = 144. Partition V by bass-in-parent-scale: 84 in, 60 out; Φ(a,m) = (a, a+S[m]) is bijective — without making the five-note cluster a mode. Of the 60 outside basses only 12 fit another major collection. The comma retains the ratio-history: κ = (3/2)¹²/2⁷ = 531441/524288 — distinct from 9/8.

text.title: Observer, Instrument, and the Musical-Epistemic Return
text.italic: The score, the signal and the interpretation are three distinct inputs to the return.
text.body: Four surfaces — FFT/STFT, CQT, chromagram, cymatic observation — each making a relation available while retaining different information. Frequency becomes an address: ν = 12·log₂(f/f_C), p = round(ν) mod 12, reference named. The projection is coarse: the comma, ≈23.46 cents, hides under a semitone bin. V–I as CF5→CF1 — {7,11,2} then {0,4,7} — needs ordered arrivals; a pooled histogram cannot tell the cadence from its reversal.
